title: Consumer Mediation Cell Quarterly Report Submission

content.scenario: A new consumer mediation cell is established in Delhi and is attached to the National Commission. The cell is unsure about the procedure for submitting its quarterly report.
content.outcome: The consumer mediation cell shall submit a quarterly report to the National Commission in the manner specified by regulations, as per section 74(5) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: How often must a consumer mediation cell submit a report?
What is the procedure for submitting a quarterly report by a consumer mediation cell?
Can a consumer mediation cell submit a quarterly report in any format?
